scope: Actual native Windows child, disposable PostgreSQL schemas, synthetic books only

contract.delayed: At least three seconds before later-book acceptance; expiry remains 15 seconds
contract.condition_cost: If any currently observed book spread >=10 bps or either side visible depth <100 USD, all profiles for that tick use at least 5 bps adverse slippage and at most 5% participation
contract.cost_basis: Existing engine embeds fees/spread/depth once; no deduction from net labels
contract.continuity: Exact recorded state chain, allowing only recorded study_bars/book_sequences
contract.gap: Never insert observations, assume intra-gap fills, or reset to the recorded account
contract.limits: One child, two processors, IDLE priority, 256 MiB, 25 seconds, eight queued runs
contract.assumptions: Delay/condition thresholds are modeled stresses, not measured venue behavior
contract.unsupported: Maker queue, base/BNB fees, hidden liquidity and own market impact

limits: Finite synthetic software proof; no real feed latency, edge or horizon acceptance
